headline: Build a Private Job Search Machine
lede: AI Job Search turns the application process into a repeatable build: ingest your history, rank opportunities, draft tailored documents, and review every result. Its local, command-driven workflow keeps personal data close while leaving room for new portals and personal rules.

headline: OpenCode Reaches 217,128 Stars
lede: OpenCode brings coding agents to both the terminal and desktop, pairing plan-and-build modes with explicit permission for commands and file edits. The project’s scale signals sustained interest in configurable, open alternatives for agent-assisted development.

headline: Give Coding Agents A Memory They Can Audit
lede: ai-memory captures sessions, decisions, tool calls, and handoffs into a git-backed Markdown knowledge base. Sanitized records, local search, optional vector retrieval, and zero-LLM defaults make continuity portable without surrendering control of the archive.

headline: Compose Generative Media As A Living Graph
lede: ComfyUI turns image, video, audio, 3D, and text workflows into connected visual nodes. Reusable graphs, selective re-execution, model offloading, and broad model support let creators tune complex pipelines without hiding the machinery.

headline: Ruflo Organizes Agents Into An Operating System
lede: Ruflo adds an execution architecture around familiar AI coding tools, routing work across specialized agents, persistent memory, and autonomous swarms. Its Rust engine, federated communication, and plugin layer describe a system built for coordinated, stateful engineering rather than isolated prompts.

headline: Orca Runs Parallel Coding Workspaces
lede: Orca gives teams one control surface for multiple coding agents, isolating their work in Git worktrees before comparison and merge. Desktop, mobile, SSH, issue tracking, and remote monitoring turn scattered agent sessions into an operational workspace.

headline: Headroom Compresses The Agent Context Stream
lede: Headroom reduces the token weight of logs, files, tool results, RAG responses, and conversation history before they reach a model. Local compressors, cache-aware routing, and recoverable originals preserve access to detail while easing cost and context pressure.

headline: A Prerequisite Graph For What Children Learn
lede: Marble Skill Taxonomy maps 1,590 elementary-school micro-topics across eight subjects and links them through 3,221 prerequisite relationships. Open JSON, evidence fields, standards links, and validation tools make the collection ready for curriculum research and adaptive learning systems.

headline: Jasna Repairs Mosaic Regions Frame By Frame
lede: Jasna detects mosaic areas, tracks them through video, and restores only the affected regions with GPU-accelerated models. Its preview editor, command line, VR180 support, and selectable enhancement stages make a specialized experiment practical to inspect and refine.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Desktop Apps A Command Surface
lede: CLI-Anything packages applications such as Blender, Kdenlive, Obsidian, and Zotero behind predictable command-line harnesses that agents can discover and execute. Standardized skills, testing, input sanitization, and a shared registry turn complex desktop workflows into rugged, scriptable operations.
